Why do I long to worship and enjoy His presence. Why do I always want to come to Him and lean on His bosom by singing .

May God use this song and put a desire in many hearts to enjoy His bosom, & may He use this song to draw many to His intimate presence.

🌸 राधे कृष्ण! जय श्रीकृष्ण! 💙

“कान्हा गं बाई हळुच मारतो खडा” या लोकप्रिय गवळणीसह TOP 06 मराठी गवळणींचा हा सुंदर संग्रह कृष्णभक्ती आणि मराठी लोकपरंपरेचा सुरेल अनुभव देतो.

गोकुळातील कृष्णलीला, कान्हाची खोडकर बालरूपातील लीला आणि राधा-कृष्णाच्या भक्तीभावाने रंगलेल्या या गवळणी मनाला आनंद देणाऱ्या आहेत.

🎵 या संग्रहात ऐका:

मराठी गवळणी
कृष्णाच्या गवळणी
कान्हाच्या गवळणी
गोकुळातील गाणी
राधा-कृष्ण भक्तिगीते
पारंपरिक मराठी गवळणी

जन्माष्टमी, गोकुळाष्टमी, दहीहंडी, कृष्णभजन, कीर्तन आणि भक्तिमय वातावरणासाठी हा गवळणी संग्रह नक्की ऐका.

🙏 जय श्रीकृष्ण! राधे राधे! 🙏

snippet.title: Champawa Ki Kaliyan - Maati Baani | Jeewan Ram | Sayo Komada| New Bhojpuri Song
snippet.description:
When the textures of Bhojpuri language meets the suaveness of Japanese culture, it's bound to be an interesting collaboration! Chamapawa ki Kaliyan is a song in which the woman in love asks her to lover to get her Champa flowers as he returns from foreign lands. 

The song features Jeevan Ram and Dhobiya Nritya dancers from Ghazipur, India and Sayo Komada from Japan, woven together in the inimitable MaatiBaani Style.

Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/track/3XgeGTP5TkrG9fx6ZHvqzx?si=4127d60d11cf4b64
